game_title: Not Negator – Coral Reef Shallows Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely. Each round, a new sea charts challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stealth value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of sea charts by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
